newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AssiDoman says raised price of sack paper.
newsitem.headline: AssiDoman says raised price of sack paper.

text.p: Swedish forestry group AssiDoman said on Wednesday it raised prices of brown sack paper in Europe by eight percent on June 1.
It also said a price rise for cardboard was imminent.
"We have raised prices on brown sack paper in Europe buy about eight percent as of June 1," AssiDoman's chief executive Lennart Ahlgren told a news conference.
"With cardboard we are starting to take away discounts and a price rise lies around the corner."
But Ahlgren was uncertain about pulp prices.
"Here you have to issue a warning," he said. "It has been looking a bit better but I don't dare to say that the trend will last."
This spring's price rise of liner in central and western Europe has gone through and in Scandinavia prices will be raised shortly, he said.
Corrugated board prices have stabilised but it is too early to talk about a price rise, Ahlgren said.
Overall forestry trends are gradually improving and prices increasing, he added.
